title: Deeper/broader dynamic-block witness route and cross-project issue reconciliation
mode: Primary-source web review plus local plan/source audit; plan update only
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Refresh dynamic-block support evidence and determine whether new open-source authoring routes can safely unblock existing PAR-133.
Reconcile current ACadSharp TABLECONTENT and SPLINE issue reports with local existing owners.
Add an optional, non-blocking scratch-witness procedure while retaining strict refusal and current support/evidence boundaries.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review and local source/plan audit; research receipt and plan edited
method.limitations: OpenCADStudio v2026.42 is a candidate local producer only. Release notes do not prove that its dynamic-block authoring emits the exact BLOCKLOOKUPACTION class/type unresolved in PAR-133 or prove external compatibility. The release artifact was not run, and its exact lock-resolved codec revision was not bound to the published binary. Peer reports remain route-specific and are not local reproductions.

sources.observed: The v2026.42 release advertises dynamic-block parameter/action authoring, lookup tables, and Test Block evaluation. The application documents a save_verified flow that writes and reopens through its own codec. The app codec is ACadRust-derived; current mutable manifests and release artifacts must not be conflated without exact lock/source binding.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Candidate scratch producer and same-codec application consistency route only. Does not establish exact BLOCKLOOKUPACTION emission, normative DWG layout, independent reader correctness, native acceptance, or dynamic-block interoperability.

sources.observed: Merged dynamic-block support is partial per its own PR description for edited-instance parameter relationships. Issue #1264 reports a block-cell value-type mismatch between a DWG model and an AutoCAD-saved DXF projection. Issue #1299 reports bad converted SPLINE data but does not state the offending arrays, handle, expected curve, or machine-checkable downstream diagnostic in the issue body.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer implementation/report evidence only; not a normative schema or libdxfrw reproduction. #1264 and #1299 remain assigned to existing PAR-126 and PAR-22 owners.

sources.observed: The project class inventory is useful for maturity/type census and comparison planning.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Class maturity and implementation declarations do not prove exact field decoding, complete graph closure, or semantic behavior.

localCrosswalk.owner: PAR-133 / PAR-07 dynamic-block type and object-graph boundary
localCrosswalk.observed: The current tree has a dynamic-block callback/model route and a focused control that refuses export without a qualified serializer. PAR-133 records the unresolved type-528 BLOCKLOOKUPACTION parser path; dynamic-block export should remain fail-closed.
localCrosswalk.disposition: No local parser/writer defect established by this research. Add only a conditional scratch witness at the already planned composed checkpoint; verify exact class/type and artifact pins before use, then add a generated in-memory vector only after ODA and observed wire boundaries are reconciled.

localCrosswalk.observed: ACadSharp #1264 describes a peer model mismatch between a Block-tagged DWG cell and an AutoCAD DXF empty-string projection; local controls already retain EMPTY, UNKNOWN, block reference, and incomplete states distinctly.
localCrosswalk.disposition: Keep fail-closed/incomplete semantics. Do not synthesize an empty DWG CadValue from DXF projection or add a duplicate test absent an ODA/producer-backed discrepancy.

localCrosswalk.observed: ACadSharp #1299 remains an under-specified peer conversion complaint; the body does not provide enough machine-checkable curve data to compare with the local parser/writer.
localCrosswalk.disposition: Retain the existing requirement for source and emitted arrays plus an independent analytic curve/metric expectation. Do not download or commit the report attachment.

assessment.planEffect: Adds an optional, pin-bound scratch-producer witness recipe to existing PAR-133. Exact CLASSES/type verification is a prerequisite; if unavailable, mark NOT_RUN/UNBOUND and continue. Existing fail-closed output, fast per-slice validation, and external qualification policies remain unchanged.
